steps: In Microsoft Sentinel, open Data connectors > RedRays SAP Security Findings and select Deploy. Sentinel creates a data collection endpoint (DCE), a data collection rule (DCR), eight Analytics tables and a Microsoft Entra application with a client secret and the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the DCR.
Copy the tenant ID, application (client) ID, client secret, DCE URI and DCR immutable ID from the connector page into RedRays. The client secret is shown only once.
Send a test record, then enable the integration and save the schedule. Test success means Azure accepted the record. Check RedRaysExportHealth_CL in the workspace to verify visibility.

Enable the desired analytics rules after reviewing the first baseline. Initial import generates no finding alerts unless alertOnBaseline is enabled. Set the workbook heartbeat threshold above your export interval and ingestion delay.
Create the workbook from the Content Hub template and select the workspace.
limitations: TimeGenerated is the time RedRays captures an export snapshot. Original source times are exported separately.

The supplied analytics rules have a one-day lookback and do not alert on older backlog. Adapt the lookback and frequency to your delivery delay. Workbook heartbeat monitoring requires a previously received heartbeat in the selected time range. Configure Azure Monitor log search alerts separately for operational notifications.
Delivery is at least once. Stable EventId and Revision support query deduplication but do not promise exactly-once incident creation.
ABAP and vulnerability findings retain source-record identity. Cross-scan semantic deduplication is not inferred.
Password findings are persisted positive detections, not completed audit runs. Legacy Java detections have no detection timestamp.
Profile parameter values are exported only for an explicit allowlist. Custom parameters are unrated and do not export their values.
Deleted source rows do not automatically resolve findings. Intermediate source edits between polls are not a complete audit trail.
Finding status changes do not automatically close existing Sentinel incidents.
Client secret is returned to users with SETTINGS_VIEW, as agreed for this version.
